messages:
maya: Greenwave deploy to eu-west starting in ~15m. Preflight SLO crosscheck running — tagging @liam and eng-platform for an early eyeball. Plan: canary -> v2.4.0 (service-embedder). If anyone sees >0.3% error or p95 > +15% vs baseline, call a pause/rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy started: rolling to eu-west. Canary group=greenwave, target=service-embedder, image=redwood/embed:2.4.0, rollout_id=rw-2387

ops-bot: Preflight SLO results (sample window=5m): p95 baseline=120ms, canary sample p95=130ms (+8%). error rate baseline=0.20%, canary=0.50% (observed spike). CPU steady, heap.allocs trending up on canary nodes.

liam: I can see the 0.5% bump on the SLO dashboard (threshold 0.4%). Can someone paste top error classes / logs for the canary pods?

samira: pulling logs now. Top error: new grpc timeout from reranker host across multiple pods. example: ```grpc deadline exceeded: rpc error code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded``` Also seeing some `oom_kill` flags in one host's dmesg.

nora: are we shifting traffic or still warming? Canary instances show an alloc/GC spike during startup in metrics (heap.allocs +40% over baseline during the first 3 mins). Could be a regression in startup memory usage in 2.4.0.

maya: Pause the traffic shift. @deploy-bot pause-canary (hold at current 12%). Notify rollout channel and ops.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift paused by maya. Holding at 12%. Rollout status: PAUSED. Alerts posted to #deploy-watch.

liam: Good call to pause. Options: rollback canary image to 2.3.1, or scale canary up and investigate further. Rolling back is safest for customer impact. Thoughts?

samira: +1 rollback. We should revert canary image to `redwood/embed:2.3.1` and run the same preflight queries again. I'll capture exact failing traces and attach to the ticket.

maya: Agreed. @deploy-bot rollback-canary service-embedder to redwood/embed:2.3.1. Also please create an incident ticket: "embed: GC/regression suspected in 2.4.0" with tags: rollout, canary, eu-west.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollback for service-embedder canary -> redwood/embed:2.3.1. Rollback started, expected completion ~90s. Issue created: RW-ISSUE-4543 (embed GC/regression).

ops-bot: Post-rollback quick metrics (1m window): p95=118ms, error rate=0.17%, heap.allocs back to baseline. Canary group stabilized.

liam: Thanks all. Hold full rollout until morning and add a note to release notes: "rollback: image 2.4.0 due to GC/timeout regression on canary". We'll triage tomorrow with perf traces and GC profiles.

maya: Added release note and linked RW-ISSUE-4543. Setting follow-up triage at 09:00 UTC. If anyone sees further anomalies overnight, ping oncall. :white_check_mark:
